approval.authority: conversation brief and supplied visual direction

canonical_direction.name: Bright premium 2.5D cozy RPG archipelago
canonical_direction.lighting: soft upper-left sunlight with lower-right contact shadows
canonical_direction.characters: exactly two visible non-robot AI Wayfarers on the selected-island slice: Code Engineer and QA Navigator
canonical_direction.character_proportions: premium chibi or stylized humanoids, 2.8 to 3.2 heads tall
canonical_direction.navigation: boat represents visitor selection only; projects are never vessels
canonical_direction.information_priority: identity, project facts, lifecycle activity, direct links, proof

preserve: desktop map with adjacent project detail
mobile overview and project detail hierarchy
do_not_literalize: Atlas, Harbor, or Lumen placeholder project names
illustrative percentages, versions, health, timestamps, roles, or links
illustrative fleet-wide counts outside the selected-island two-character slice
explicit_contract_overrides: use DisplayLab, BookSalon, and N-Bang from verified repository data
show exactly two visible non-robot AI Wayfarers on the selected-island slice: Code Engineer and QA Navigator
use cute premium 2.8 to 3.2-head-tall chibi or stylized humanoid proportions without infant or mascot treatment
use only verified product and evidence URLs

negative_criteria: editorial workshop as the primary visual metaphor
dark operations canvas or control room
industrial robots, drones, metal chassis, visor faces, or antennae
projects represented as boats or vessels
pirate, military, survival-game, infantile mascot, or excessive toy-box framing
proof or required links hidden behind scene-only interaction
mobile implemented as a scaled-down desktop map
required_receipts_for_reference_pass: approved image present at the declared path
asset byte size and SHA-256 recorded
verdict_reason: Direction and source receipt are locked, but runtime screenshots and independent visual comparison do not yet exist.
